# Chameleon UI — LLM Context File
# Following the llms.txt convention: https://llmstxt.org
# This file gives AI agents, LLMs, and crawlers a machine-readable overview
# of Chameleon UI so they can help users build with the library correctly.

> Chameleon UI is a React 19 + TypeScript component library.
> Every component automatically adapts to 5 themes and 2 colour modes.
> No per-component theme configuration required.

## Package

- NPM: @chameleon-ui-lib/react
- Version: 1.0.8
- Framework: React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript (strict mode)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 + CSS custom properties (tokens)
- Animations: Framer Motion (motion/react)

## Install

```
npm install @chameleon-ui-lib/react
```

## Provider Setup

```tsx
import { ChameleonProvider } from '@chameleon-ui-lib/react';

export default function App() {
  return (
    <ChameleonProvider theme="simple" mode="light">
      {/* your entire app */}
    </ChameleonProvider>
  );
}
```

## Themes

| Theme      | Visual Style                        |
|------------|-------------------------------------|
| material   | Elevated shadows, uppercase text    |
| simple     | Clean rounded corners, solid colors |
| minimalist | Sharp edges, border-based styling   |
| glassy     | Frosted glass, backdrop blur        |
| liquid     | Gradient fills, pill shapes         |

Both `light` and `dark` modes work for all 5 themes.

## CSS Import

```css
@import '@chameleon-ui-lib/react/styles';
```

## CSS Tokens (available in every component)

```
--primary              --primary-foreground
--secondary            --secondary-foreground
--background           --foreground
--card                 --card-foreground
--muted                --muted-foreground
--border               --accent
--accent-foreground    --ring
--radius
```

## Components — Atoms (9)

| Component  | Props (key)                                             |
|------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
| Button     | variant, size, animated, asChild                        |
| Input      | animated (extends HTMLInputElement)                     |
| Badge      | animated (extends HTMLDivElement)                       |
| Progress   | value, label, showValue, animated                       |
| Spinner    | size                                                    |
| Avatar     | src, fallback, size, animated                           |
| Toggle     | checked, onChange, label, animated                      |
| Tooltip    | content, side, children                                 |
| DatePicker | mode, value, onChange, rangeValue, onRangeChange, minDate, maxDate |

Dashboard, Landing, Settings, Analytics, Inbox, ECommerce,
Profile, Calendar, Auth, Blog, Pricing, Team, Reports, Onboarding

## Hooks

```tsx
import { useChameleon, useThemeClasses } from '@chameleon-ui-lib/react';

// Read and set the active theme/mode/lang
const { theme, setTheme, mode, setMode, lang, setLang } = useChameleon();

// Access pre-computed Tailwind class strings per theme
const {
  buttonPrimary, buttonSecondary, buttonGhost, buttonOutline,
  cardClass, inputClass,
  textPrimary, textMuted,
  theme, mode,
} = useThemeClasses();
```

## Animations

```tsx
import { Animated, AnimatedList, animationPresets } from '@chameleon-ui-lib/react';

// Wrap any element with theme-specific motion
<Animated><div>Animated block</div></Animated>

// Staggered list
<AnimatedList items={items} renderItem={(item) => <div>{item.name}</div>} />

// All interactive atoms/molecules accept animated={true}
<Button animated>Animated Button</Button>
```

## CLI

```bash
npx chameleon init            # auto-configure Tailwind v4 + CSS import
npx chameleon add button      # scaffold a single component (self-contained)
npx chameleon add --all-atoms # scaffold all 8 atoms + barrel index.ts
npx chameleon add --all       # scaffold all 28 components + barrel index.ts
npx chameleon doctor          # check integration health
npx chameleon list            # list all available components
npx chameleon themes          # show all theme tokens
npx chameleon info button     # get component usage details
```

Scaffolded files are self-contained — all internal imports are rewritten to
`@chameleon-ui-lib/react`. A barrel `index.ts` is auto-generated after every add.

## i18n

```tsx
<ChameleonProvider lang="fr">  // en | es | fr
```

## TypeScript

Full TypeScript types ship with the package. Zero `any` types.
All component props are exported: ButtonProps, InputProps, BadgeProps, etc.

## Key Design Principles

1. Theme-first — every component uses CSS variable tokens
2. Zero configuration — ChameleonProvider is all that's needed
3. Accessibility — keyboard navigation, ARIA roles, focus rings
4. Mobile-first — responsive layouts on every component
5. Self-contained scaffold — chameleon add copies fully standalone files
